objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact subject to creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving with version control and approval workflows.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedure Instruction, Work Instruction

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code assigned to a document

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential iteration of a document through its lifecycle

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state in the release workflow such as Editing, Review, Released, Out of Force

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which a document version becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which a document version expires and requires validity extension

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Duration defining how long a document remains valid before requiring a validity check

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Primary user responsible for creating and signing the document

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional user with change rights but no workflow signature responsibility

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: User responsible for checking document content for technical and formal aspects

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: User responsible for approving document release and publication

attributes.name: reader_group
attributes.description: User group assigned read authorization to view the document

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or objects related to this document

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Relevant IT system or application associated with the document

attributes.name: company
attributes.description: Organizational entity for which the document has validity

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Business or geographic area where the document applies

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Textual or media-based information contained in the document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document supplement automatically released with the main document and subject to its version lifecycle.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential iteration of the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state aligned with main document release process

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an archived attachment is retained

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: An uncontrolled document supplement not subject to release cycles or version control of the main document.

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is published or unpublished

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A managed request to amend an existing released document without affecting its version history.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: User who created the change proposal

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as Pending or Completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: An automated system-generated request to review and confirm continued validity of a versioned document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow state

attributes.name: creation_trigger
attributes.description: Automatic trigger when document reaches 30 days before validity expiration

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A managed request to declare a document invalid and remove it from circulation.

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: User who created the override request

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow state

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A managed request to restore a previously invalidated document to active status.

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: User from Business Admin group who created the reactivation request

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow state

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual system participant with assigned roles and permissions in document management.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, Translator, Business Admin

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: Read and write permissions assigned to the user

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users with shared authorization and role assignments.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Shared system role such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Archive

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: Collective read and write permissions for group members

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained collection of users and user groups assigned to receive document notifications or acknowledgements.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Method of distribution such as Email Notification or Acknowledgement Required

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature documentation recorded during workflow approval.

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User who provided the signature

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which signature was applied such as Creator, Review, Release

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A structured approval process with defined steps and participant roles.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of workflow such as Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Individual stages in the workflow process

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User or user group assigned to complete a workflow step

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current progress state of the workflow

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A documented confirmation by a user that they have received and reviewed a distributed document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is pending

attributes.name: recipient
attributes.description: User who must provide acknowledgement

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined structure or format for creating new documents of a specified type.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Category of document the template applies to

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Base format such as MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific display providing users with relevant documents and workflow information.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Intended user role such as Reader, Author, Business Admin

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Information displayed based on user's distribution list assignments

objs.name: report
objs.description: A structured evaluation providing filtered information about documents based on selection criteria.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Intended user role such as Reader, Author, Business Admin

attributes.name: selection_criteria
attributes.description: Parameters used to filter and organize report results

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group with continued read access to archived documents after general rights revocation.

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: Read-only access to archived documents

attributes.name: member
attributes.description: User belonging to the archive group

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference information that documents can be linked to such as processes, organizational units, or risks.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of master data such as Process, Organizational Unit, Risk, IT Application

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Instantiation of a new document object with document type selection and optional template assignment.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modification of document content and properties after creation.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Addition of external content to a document object.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Creation or modification of document attributes and properties grouped in categories.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of document from source format to PDF display format.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of an attachment for archiving upon next main document release.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Definition of read and write permissions for users or user groups on documents and details.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Specification of users or user groups to complete workflow steps.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Addition of a controlled document supplement to a document.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Addition of an uncontrolled document supplement to a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Initiation of a managed amendment request for an existing document.

evts.name: initiate_release_workflow
evts.description: Start of the 3-step approval process consisting of Creator, Review, and Release steps.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Provision of electronic signature by workflow participant at designated workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assessment of document content for technical and formal correctness by designated reviewer.

evts.name: approve_release
evts.description: Final approval and authorization for document publication by designated releaser.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: Denial of document approval during review step with workflow cancellation.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: Denial of document approval during release step with workflow cancellation.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication and visibility to assigned readers following successful release.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new editing version following modification of released document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completion of implemented change proposal amendments.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatic system generation of validity check request when document approaches expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirmation of continued validity and update of valid until date by authorized participant.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiation of managed request to declare document invalid and remove from circulation.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Formal declaration of document invalidity with archiving and authorization revocation.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiation of managed request to restore previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restoration of previously invalidated document to active status with new version creation.

evts.name: distribute_by_email_notification
evts.description: Automatic email notification to users in distribution list upon document release.

evts.name: distribute_by_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic email workflow task to users requiring active acknowledgement confirmation.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: User confirmation that document has been received and reviewed.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Creation of language-dependent version of released document for authorization review.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Assessment of translated document content and properties by designated reviewer.

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Final approval of translated document version by designated releaser.

evts.name: notify_workflow_status
evts.description: Automatic email notification to workflow participants regarding status changes and pending tasks.

evts.name: display_dashboard
evts.description: Presentation of role-specific documents and workflow information based on distribution assignments.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Creation of filtered evaluation of documents based on selected parameters and criteria.

o2o.description: Document references other documents for context or dependencies.

Override request is created for a document to be invalidated.
Reactivation request is created for a previously invalidated document.
